correctness.rationale: The equal-weight hypothesis fixes all complement row norms as sqrt(2/m). Orthogonal completion and Jacobi minors give the exact minor-normalization factor. Planar convex-hull Carathéodory forces a chord with squared length at least three from zero-sum unit phases; equality forces exactly three equally populated cubic-root phases. An explicit orthogonal completion realizes every m divisible by three. Compactness and existence give a strict positive gap at other fixed m. The exact-rational checker verifies every full-size minor for m=6,9,12, but the universal proof is analytic.

value.rationale: Unit-norm tight frames are the canonical equal-leverage subclass of labelled identity decompositions. A strictly improved and sharp finite-codimension determinant guarantee (factor 5/4 at m=6 tending to 3/2), with complete exact equality and divisibility rigidity, is a structural geometric selection result beyond a routine isolated example. Neither arbitrary weight problems nor other codimensions are claimed.
